title: Memory and precision in noiseless Gaussian regression
summary: For every fixed A > 0, a learner that retains at most $`Ad^2`$ bits between fresh exact Gaussian linear measurements needs $`\Omega_A(d\log(1/\epsilon))`$ measurements to estimate a uniformly random unit vector to angular error at most ϵ , for any $`0\lt \epsilon\le 1/10`$, with probability at least 2/3. The constant is absolute for $`o(d^2)`$ memory.
family_title: Memory–sample lower bounds for noiseless Gaussian regression

review.reason: Derives measurement lower bounds for learners with bounded memory estimating a random unit vector.
